title: Prototype pollution: recursive merge writes user keys onto the shared prototype
index_line: T-0008 · CODE_EXEC · __proto__/constructor.prototype through a merge · gadget decides the effect · corroborated
invariant_violated: The app treats JSON keys as properties of one object; a recursive merge writes them onto the shared prototype, changing behavior for every object.

mechanism.does: attacker JSON body with __proto__ / constructor.prototype keys hits a merge endpoint
key lands on Object.prototype (merge does not special-case the prototype chain)
later code reads the inherited property — the gadget: template option, spawn option, auth flag, jwt verify options
RCE via child_process/EJS/Pug/Handlebars options, or AUTH_DECISION via isAdmin/role flip, or alg:none via jsonwebtoken options

source.http.body.value: JSON body on a POST/PUT/PATCH merge-capable endpoint

sink.merge.recursive.value: Object.assign / _.merge / _.defaultsDeep / $.extend(deep) / custom deepMerge on user JSON

gadget.prototype.value: EJS outputFunctionName · NODE_OPTIONS --require · child_process shell/argv0 · isAdmin/role/verified flip · jsonwebtoken algorithms:['none']

guard.none.value: merge must not sanitize __proto__/constructor keys — most don't

preconditions.expr: varies — merge endpoints usually authenticated user

success: a fresh empty object reflects the polluted property ({}.polluted === value)
admin/role flag flips on an account that should not have it
jsonwebtoken accepts an alg:none token after options pollution
failure_like: merge uses Object.create(null) targets or sanitizes __proto__/constructor keys
own property shadows the prototype on every read path
false_positive: client-side-only pollution — browser page, no server merge
gadget property exists but no code path ever reads it

hazards: the gadget depends on package.json contents — enumerate the template/auth libs before choosing
browser-side variant exists but is a different impact class (XSS/DOM)
non_transfers: go/rust/java — no shared mutable prototype; the nearest analogue (config-merge confusion) is a different record
